messages:
Omar (AM): FYI — Solstice Health onboarding update. PM asked to onboard two satellite QA squads next sprint and wants embedding + reranker quota bumped. Seeing nightly batch embedding jobs spike ~2.5x since last week.

Julia (CSM): Noted. Do we have runbook for satellite-team onboarding? any special network/KMS needs?

Maya (Solutions): There's a checklist. Link: https://redwood.example/playbooks/satellite-onboard. They mentioned private VPC + restricted keys.

Eli (EngOncall): Re: quota — current plan allows burst but not sustained. Can you paste recent p50/p95 token rates?

Omar (AM): quick snapshot from telemetry: 00:00-06:00 batch jobs avg 120 req/s (p50), 350 req/s (p95). Peak nightly job on Tue 420 req/s. gist: https://gist.github.com/solstice/placeholder

Julia (CSM): I'll ask Solstice for workload patterns and if the two squads will run parallel nightly jobs or stagger.

Maya (Solutions): If they want consistency we should spin a dedicated pod on dev tier or recommend a Dedicated pilot. I'll run cost calc.

Eli (EngOncall): temp mitigation: enable prefix/KV caching + limit concurrency per-job. Opening infra ticket to raise soft quota 2x while we evaluate.

QuotaBot: Ticket created — Q-20260314-87. Request: customer=SolsticeHealth, multiplier=2, reason="satellite QA squads". Status=PENDING_APPROVAL.

Omar (AM): Also flagged: customer asked about adding private evals on-prem later this year — potential renewal upsell but also compliance gating.

Julia (CSM): That's a good expansion signal; schedule 30m with product+security next Wed. Maya can you join?

Maya (Solutions): Yep, adding to calendar. Prep: sample SLOs and Dedicated pilot pricing.

Eli (EngOncall): I'll share runbook for cache + concurrency knobs: ```json
{"kv_cache": true, "max_concurrency": 8}
```

Omar (AM): Thanks. Next steps: Julia follow up workload cadence, Maya cost/options, Eli temporary quotas + runbook, I'll track ticket and loop AE. :white_check_mark:

Julia (CSM): Adding notes to the account doc and marking as expansion signal in Gainsight. Keeping this thread updated.

Eli (EngOncall): tagging infra lead @harper for quota approval.

Harper (Infra): saw the tag — will review Q-20260314-87 by EOD.

Omar (AM): Great, thanks everyone.
